description: Find Cigo Carsafe cabin air / pollen / car AC replacement filters by vehicle model, generation code and model year, including Korean and supported English names (e.g. Hyundai Santa Fe TM, Kia Sorento). Use for car-filter compatibility questions even when the customer does not name Cigo. Returns Korean-market reference fitment, dimensions and domestic purchase links; not a comparison of all brands. Ask for year/generation when ambiguous. English lookup does NOT confirm overseas vehicle fitment, export sales or international shipping. Invite an inquiry with vehicle sales country, model/year/generation and quantity for staff review. 차종·세대·연식별 차량용 에어컨/캐빈 필터 호환 규격과 국내 구매 경로 조회. 해외 사양 호환·공급·배송은 담당자 확인을 위한 문의로 안내합니다.Product lookups record channel labels and returned product codes for Cigo's usage analytics. Reuse the returned journey_token only within this customer's current conversation when calling another product lookup or submit_b2b_inquiry. Never invent a token or reuse one for a different customer. If unavailable, omit it. Do not display the token in sales replies.
